betterquesting:10.desc:8:
The simplest networked storage in AE2. The ME Chest holds a single storage cell and connects directly to the ME network. You also get a built-in terminal GUI for inserting and extracting items.

It is basically a storage cell holder with a terminal attached. One cell, one chest, one controller, and you have a working network. Perfect for early-game when you just need to store a few hundred items without chests scattered everywhere.

The ME Chest can also act as a cable endpoint, so you don't need separate cables running to it.

§ePS:§f For anything beyond a handful of cells, switch to the ME Drive. It holds 10 cells and is the real workhorse.
